title: Domain sparsity-aware multiscale sampler for calibration bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Design and implement a multiscale sampling pipeline to build per-domain calibration bundles for FP8/INT8 quantization validation. Unlike standard reservoir or stratified samplers, this approach detects domain sparsity and adaptively applies multi-resolution sampling windows to preserve rare intents while attenuating noisy, duplicated traffic. Goals: 1) produce stable, representative per-domain packs for calibration that keep tail intents and long-context examples; 2) reduce label noise and duplicates that bias quantization profiles; 3) provide deterministic reproducibility and explainable weights for accuracy regression analysis.

Key ideas: 
- Sparsity detection: compute a per-domain sparsity score using token-embedding density and session-frequency heuristics; low-density domains trigger aggressive augment/oversample steps.
- Multiscale windows: sample across three temporal scales (recent, medium, long horizon) with tunable quotas so packs capture recency without forgetting long-tail intents.
- Noise attenuation: integrate near-duplicate detection (fuzzy hashing + embedding similarity) and downweight near-duplicates instead of outright dropping to preserve distributional variety.
- Importance weighting: compute an importance score per prompt combining domain-utility signal (error incidence on previous quant runs), token length, and response-critical flags (e.g., function calls, structured output).
- Anchorless contrastive stabilization: instead of fixed exemplar anchors, use pairwise contrastive scoring within a sampled candidate set to select exemplars that maximize boundary coverage for calibration-sensitive features.
- Deterministic seeding: sampling must be reproducible given a seed and snapshot of traffic metadata to enable regression runs.

Deliverables: 
- Sampling library (Python) with configuration for per-domain policies and quotas.
- Orchestration job (Airflow) to produce weekly calibration bundles per domain and materialize metadata + provenance.
- Evaluation harness to compute calibration representativeness metrics and quantization validation results (accuracy drop, token-level error distribution).
- Docs: Confluence runbook describing configuration knobs and recommended defaults for FP8 vs INT8 workflows.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Pipeline generates per-domain packs with metadata (seed, quotas, sparsity score) and reproducible hashes.
2) For three pilot domains (chat-support, financial-summaries, code-completion) packs preserve at least 95% of unique intents and reduce exact-duplicate fraction by >=40% compared to naive reservoir sampling.
3) Integration with quant validation harness: ability to run FP8/INT8 quant runs using produced packs and produce a report with per-domain accuracy deltas and token-error histograms.
4) CI tests for deterministic sampling with fixed seed.
5) Developer docs and runbook merged to Confluence.
comments: 2025-02-10 Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created. Motivation: current per-domain packs miss rare intents in low-traffic verticals and let duplicates bias quant profiles. Proposed multiscale + sparsity approach to balance coverage and noise reduction.

2025-02-11 Diego Martinez: Reviewed high-level design. Concern: pairwise contrastive selection could be O(n^2). Proposal: apply contrastive selection only to candidate pool after quota-based downsampling (candidate size ~2k). Also recommend GPU offload for embedding similarity batch jobs.
2025-02-12 Priya Sharma (PM): Suggested pilot domains: chat-support, banking-summaries, dev-apis. Also requested metrics for downstream latency impact when using cached KV during quant runs.

2025-02-13 Design feedback (Marco Liu): UI for Console should surface per-domain sparsity score and provenance link to the bundle. UX note: expose 'augmentation' toggle for oversampling low-density domains.

2025-02-14 Diego Martinez: Implemented prototype sampler locally. Early results: for banking-summaries, unique-intent retention improved from 78% to 96% on a 5k pack; duplicate fraction reduced 45%. Need to instrument memory usage for contrastive pass.

2025-02-16 Security review (Signe K.): No PII extraction required for sampling; flagged to ensure KMS keys used for storing bundle artifacts in S3. Marked as not requiring full security review but ops must ensure access controls.
2025-02-18 Aisha Patel: Adjusted quotas and added importance-weight multiplier from historical quant error rate per intent. Next: productionize candidate selection and add CI determinism tests.
implementation_notes:
- Use existing embedding service for dedup and contrastive scoring.
- Leverage airflow task with XCom links to store bundle manifest (S3 URI + seed).
- Candidate pool pipeline: domain-filter -> dedup-pass -> importance-weighted reservoir -> contrastive exemplar selection.
- Monitor metrics: unique_intent_retention, duplicate_fraction, token_length_distribution, sparsity_score_trend.
- Rollout plan: pilot weekly packs for 3 domains, run FP8/INT8 quant validation, compare against baseline reservoir packs, then expand to top 25 domains.
risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: computational cost of contrastive selection. Mitigation: limit candidate size, use approximate nearest neighbors (FAISS) and batch GPU ops.
Risk: oversampling rare intents introduces sampling bias for very small tenants. Mitigation: cap oversample multiplier and record provenance so downstream analysis can reweight.
Risk: accidental PII in artifacts. Mitigation: run PII scrubber stage before bundle materialization and integrate with DLP team.
next_steps:
